ecological_scale_evidence.note: Finer territorial granularity produces smaller |β|. Threshold 0.10 calibrated on FR (280 zones) is appropriate for FR-scale analyses; PT municipal (278 units, similar scale) reaches 0.10. Sub-0.10 effects in FR and PT municipal may be structurally comparable to 0.10+ effects at coarser scales.
